item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pentagon pushes defense companies to boost weapons production after concerns of depleted stocks
item.description: The Pentagon is pressing the U.S. defense industry to accelerate production of weapons to help replenish its diminished stockpile of munitions, including those depleted in the ongoing war with Iran.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] The Tilted Teacup Tea Room in Brooksville wants you to stop scrolling and relax
item.description: The Tilted Teacup Tea Room in Brooksville wants you to stop scrolling and relax. Open Wednesday through Saturday from 11am to 3pm. Reservations required.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Was that used car flooded? How to check for flood damage before you buy
item.description: If you are planning to buy a new car, it is essential to know the warning signs that a vehicle was in a flood. Miss the red flags and you could face thousands of dollars in repairs.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Susan Solves It: Scam callers
item.description: Tampa Bay 28 Reporter Susan El Khoury advises consumers to slow down before responding to urgent calls or texts and create a family passcode to help verify loved ones.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] News to Know for Aug. 10
item.description: Manatee County schools shift focus with new strategic plan. Plus, Sarasota superintendent talks what's new in the district and teacher shortages.
